reviewed_views.view: Near frontal; eight segmented shafts, seven dark fluted upper fields, four horizontal window tiers flanking each side, blank poster display cases and the lower door canopy.
Street-height oblique; projecting Chinese/English two-sided street blade, shallow returned section, glazed entrance and central marquee.

scope_limits: No interior, reconstructed modern shopping centre or assertion of retained historic material. All dimensions and colour selected as interpretive values.
